title: LavaGolem
description: Two Copper Golems that automate the tedious parts of vanilla: one hauls lava from cauldrons, the other runs your furnaces. No resource pack, fully configurable, survives restarts.
body:
# LavaGolem

Two hard-working Copper Golems that automate the most tedious parts of vanilla - **without a resource pack, without client mods, and without breaking the survival spirit.** You still build the infrastructure yourself; the golems just save you the endless walking back and forth.

Tired of building a giant super-smelter - stacks of furnaces wired up with hoppers, minecart loops, item sorters and half a chunk of redstone just to melt some ore? Drop a **Smelter Golem** next to a few furnaces and a couple of labeled chests instead. Want your dripstone-and-cauldron lava farm collected for you? That's what the **Lava Golem** is for.

Two little golems can replace a whole room of contraptions.

---

## The two golems

### 🪣 Lava Golem - the lava hauler
Vanilla already lets you drip a lava source through pointed dripstone into a cauldron and slowly accumulate lava - but *you* have to stand there and bucket it out. The Lava Golem does that for you: it grabs an empty bucket, fills it at a full lava cauldron, and drops the lava bucket into your storage. Forever.

### 🔥 Smelter Golem - the furnace keeper
Feeds your furnaces and hauls out the results, so you don't need a hopper-and-rail smelting factory. It's genuinely smart about it:

- **Reads your stock** - takes the most abundant smeltable from the `[Smelt]` chest.
- **Picks the right fuel** - lava buckets for big batches, coal for small ones, wood if that's all you have - sized so nothing is wasted.
- **Spreads the load** - splits a big pile evenly across all your furnaces so they run in parallel, instead of dumping it all into one.
- **Closes the lava loop** - a spent lava bucket becomes an empty bucket; the golem pulls it back out and returns it, so it never clogs the furnace.
- **Work modes** - right-click a Smelter Golem to open its menu and set it to **Balanced**, **Load only**, or **Collect only**. Run one golem that loads and another that collects if you like.

---

## Recipes

Both golems share the same shape - only the center changes:

```
C R C        C = Copper Ingot
R X R        R = Redstone Dust
C R C
```

- **Lava Golem** - `X` = **Lava Bucket**
- **Smelter Golem** - `X` = **Furnace**

The result is a "Golem Heart" (a labeled Copper Golem Spawn Egg). Right-click it on the ground to place the golem.

---

## Setting up a station

Storage containers can be **chests, trapped chests, barrels or shulker boxes**. Tag each one either by:
- placing a **sign** with the matching text on any of its 6 sides, **or**
- **renaming the container itself** in an anvil to the matching text (no sign needed - cleaner build).

**Lava Golem station:** a `[Buckets]` container with empty buckets, a lava cauldron nearby, and a `[Lava]` container for the output.

**Smelter Golem station:** furnaces within range, plus containers tagged `[Smelt]` (ore/food to melt), `[Fuel]` (any vanilla fuel), and `[Output]` (finished goods - spent buckets come back here too).

Drop the matching Golem Heart nearby and it gets to work.

> Note: the Smelter currently services **regular furnaces** (blast furnaces and smokers are not handled yet).

---

## Everyday use

- **Stats / settings** - right-click a golem with an empty hand. The Lava Golem shows its stats in chat; the Smelter Golem opens a settings & stats menu.
- **Disassemble** - sneak + right-click with an empty hand. The Golem Heart drops back, along with anything it was carrying.
- **Survives restarts** - golems (and their current job and mode) are restored automatically when their chunk loads.

## Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/golemstats` | `lavagolem.admin` | Server-wide statistics |
| `/removegolems` | `lavagolem.admin` | Remove all custom golems |

## Configuration

`plugins/LavaGolem/config.yml`:

```yaml
search-radius: 8            # how far a golem looks for containers, cauldrons and furnaces
reach-distance: 2.2
search-cooldown-ticks: 40
tick-period: 10
bucket-sign-text: "[Buckets]"
lava-sign-text: "[Lava]"
smelt-sign-text: "[Smelt]"
fuel-sign-text: "[Fuel]"
output-sign-text: "[Output]"
locale: en                 # en or ru
bstats: true
```

Every tag text above works either as a sign **or** as the container's own name.

---

*Only golems created from the custom recipes are controlled - vanilla copper golems behave normally.*
